# Fixtures

Synthetic `.osu` mania maps for reference-runner baselines and future parity tests.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `synthetic-4k-sparse.osu` | 4K, sparse rice + one LN |
| `synthetic-7k-dense.osu` | 7K, short dense stream |

**Licensing:** authored for Roxysu tests; no third-party chart content.

Baselines (C# reference JSON) live under `baselines/<sha>/` when the reference runner has been executed against the pinned upstream.
